transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Well, I'm here because for nearly two years now, I've been sure that the contractor and some of the people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. 

They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. It doesn't matter how many receipts my husband shows me, or how many excuses they all give... I know what they're doing.
Have you ever heard or seen things that others around you do not seem to notice?

No, I haven't. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there, if that's what you're asking. My hearing and eyesight are just fine. I only see what is actually going on right in front of me with this house.
Have you ever had any significant medical conditions, head injuries, or do you regularly use any medications or substances?

No, I haven't had anything like that. I've always been pretty healthy. No head injuries, no big medical problems, and I don't take any regular medications... just vitamins. And I definitely don't use any, you know, substances or anything like that. My mind is perfectly clear, Doctor.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to organize your thoughts, or have others told you that your speech or actions have become difficult to follow?

No, not at all. My thoughts are perfectly organized. I know exactly what I want to say, and I say it clearly. No one has ever told me I'm hard to follow. I mean, my husband might pretend he doesn't understand what I'm telling him about the contractor, but that's just because he doesn't want to admit I'm right. My speech and my actions are just fine.
Do you feel that the contractor's actions are things that could actually happen in real life, or do you feel there is something impossible or supernatural about how they are managing to cheat you?

No, there's nothing supernatural about it at all. It's just... well, it's just plain old fraud. People get cheated by contractors all the time, so it's a very real thing that happens. 

He's just sneaking around, cutting corners, and covering his tracks when we aren't looking. There's no magic or anything impossible going on. He's just a crook who knows how to work the system.
How has this situation with the contractor affected your daily life, such as your ability to complete your household chores, maintain your social relationships, or manage your other responsibilities?

Well, honestly, it hasn't really stopped me from doing my normal things. I mean, obviously dealing with him and the remodel is a headache, but outside of that... I still keep up with everything. 

I go to my church gatherings, I still attend my book club. My regular household routines are getting done just fine, and we still keep up with our family plans exactly the way we usually do. So, no, I'm managing my responsibilities perfectly well. I just want this whole mess with the contractor sorted out so I don't have to keep watching my back.
Are there any other people, aside from the contractor and your neighbors, who you believe are involved in this situation or acting against you?

No, no one else. It's really just the contractor doing the work, and the neighbors who are letting him use their property to hide things. I don't have any reason to think anyone else is involved. It's just them.
If your husband or another trusted person were to show you definitive, undeniable proof that the contractor is not cheating you, would you be willing to reconsider your belief?

Well... no, I wouldn't. Because he already tries to do that. That's actually a big part of why I’m here. 

For nearly two years now, I’ve been completely sure that the contractor and some of the people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. They're keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. And it just doesn't change anything, no matter how many receipts my husband shows me or how many excuses they all give. I know what they're doing.
